theorem QOU.CentralExtension.PresheafCentralExtension.cechObstruction_eq_one_iff {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {X : C} {𝒜 𝓔 𝒢 : CategoryTheory.Functor Cᵒᵖ GrpCat} (E : PresheafCentralExtension 𝒜 𝓔 𝒢) {Cov : CechGerbe.Cover X → Prop} (hdir : CechGerbe.IsCoverDirected Cov) (𝒰 : CechGerbe.Cover X) (h𝒰 : Cov 𝒰) (γ : CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle 𝒢 𝒰.obj) (ξ : CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups.OneCochain 𝓔 𝒰.obj) (hξ : ∀ (i j : 𝒰.ι) ⦃T : C⦄ (a : T ⟶ 𝒰.obj i) (b : T ⟶ 𝒰.obj j), (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (E.π.app (Opposite.op T))) (ξ.ev i j a b) = γ.ev i j a b) :
E.cechObstruction 𝒰 h𝒰 γ ξ hξ = CechGerbe.cechClass 𝒰 h𝒰 CechGerbe.TwoCocycle.one ↔ ∃ (𝒲 : CechGerbe.Cover X) (_ : Cov 𝒲) (ρ : 𝒲.Refines 𝒰) (η : CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle 𝓔 𝒲.obj), ∀ (j j' : 𝒲.ι) ⦃T : C⦄ (a : T ⟶ 𝒲.obj j) (b : T ⟶ 𝒲.obj j'), (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (E.π.app (Opposite.op T))) (η.ev j j' a b) = (pullOneCocycle 𝒰.obj ρ.r ρ.f γ).ev j j' a b
